independenceRationale: The qualifying evidence comes from distinct teams and different assisted-moulding families and measurement approaches. A 2015 water-assisted programme physically evaluates residual wall thickness, cooling and surface quality, while an independent 2007 gas-assisted programme uses ultrasonic in-process measurement to infer and validate residual wall thickness. They are separate experimental programmes and not duplicate publications or re-analysis of the same hollow-part campaign.
promotionClaim: Promote the mechanism-level statement that measured gas- or water-assisted penetration and thermal history can change residual wall thickness, cooling and physical part-quality, and that the different assisted-process families require their own evidence. Do not promote any assist pressure, delay, wall thickness, temperature or penetration value as a universal rule, and do not collapse water, gas and projectile-assisted moulding into one recipe.
